auth.tagline: Your personal life management system — plan your day, build habits, reach your goals.
auth.signInSubtitle: Sign in with your Google account to continue.
auth.signUpSubtitle: Sign up with your Google account — it takes one tap.

errors.google: Could not sign in with Google. Please try again.
errors.unauthorizedDomain: This domain ({host}) is not authorised in Firebase. Add it under Authentication → Settings → Authorized domains, then try again.
errors.popupBlocked: The browser blocked the sign-in window. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
errors.popupCancelled: Sign-in was cancelled — the Google window was closed.

errors.notEnabled: Google sign-in is not enabled for this Firebase project.

auth.signInMetaDescription: Sign in to LifeOS with your Google account — daily plan, habits, goals and analytics in one place.
auth.signUpMetaDescription: Create your LifeOS account with Google — daily plan, habits, goals and analytics in one place.

landing.metaDescription: Plan the day hour by hour, keep habit streaks, break goals into steps and see what actually gets done — all behind one Google sign-in.
landing.title: Plan the day, keep the habits, reach the goals
landing.subtitle: LifeOS is a personal life management system: one place for the day and week plan, habit streaks, goals and the numbers that show what is actually working.

modules.tasks: Plan the day hour by hour and tick tasks off as they happen.
modules.week: See the whole week, review what actually happened and plan the next one.
modules.schedule: The selected day as an hour-by-hour timeline: drag a task to another hour, or click an empty slot to plan one.
modules.habits: Track streaks on a 12-week grid and see which habits hold up.
modules.goals: Connect a goal to the tasks that move it forward and see how many are done.
modules.analytics: Completion rate, productive hours and a habit overview on one screen.
modules.notes: A daily note that saves as you type, with a dated history you can scroll back through.

landing.privacyNote: Google sign-in only — everything stays under your own account.

today.title: Today
today.metaDescription: Your daily overview — tasks, habits, and goals
today.taskTitlePlaceholder: What do you want to get done?
today.emptyMessage: Add your first task for today and start planning your day.
today.withoutTime: {count, plural, one {# task without a time} other {# tasks without a time}}
today.quickAddHint: Type a title and press Enter — no time needed.
today.timeOptionalHint: Optional — without a time the task simply has no slot in the day.
today.emptyMessageOtherDay: Nothing was planned for this day. Add a task if you want to.

recovery.title: Unfinished from earlier days
recovery.hint: Nothing moves forward by itself: carry a task to tomorrow, give it a new date, or take it off the plan.
recovery.hiddenCount: {count, plural, one {# more unfinished task} other {# more unfinished tasks}}
recovery.olderHint: Older days are still there — open one with the day arrows.

validation.timeIncomplete: Add both a start and an end time, or leave both empty.
validation.timeOrder: The end time must be after the start time.

habits.title: Habits
habits.metaDescription: Track your daily habits and keep your streaks alive
habits.subtitle: Build consistency, one day at a time.

goals.title: Goals
goals.metaDescription: Long-term goals tied to your daily tasks: task progress, the next action, and all the work done for a goal.
goals.subtitle: Goals are moved by tasks — link them and the work shows up in Today
goals.goalTitlePlaceholder: e.g. Learn a new language, Run a marathon
goals.deleteMessage: Delete "{title}"? The tasks linked to it are not deleted — they stay in their days. This can't be undone.
goals.emptyMessage: Add your first goal and connect it to the work that moves it.
goals.droppedCount: {count, plural, one {# dropped task} other {# dropped tasks}}
goals.noLinkedTasksHint: No linked tasks yet — add the first one below and it shows up in Today like any other task.
goals.addTask: Add a task for this goal
goals.noOpenTasks: Nothing is open for this goal right now.
goals.notFoundMessage: It was deleted. The tasks that were linked to it are still in your days — simply without a goal.
goals.markTaskTodo: Mark the task as to do
goals.legacyNote: This goal still carries {open, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}} from the old checklist, plus {done, plural, one {# completed step} other {# completed steps}} kept as history. Moving the open ones turns them into tasks you can do and plan.
goals.legacyNoOpen: Every step is already completed — nothing left to move.
goals.legacyMoved: {count, plural, one {Moved # step to a task.} other {Moved # steps to tasks.}}

goals.legacyStepsAction: review it on the goal page
goals.finishedSectionHint: They keep all of their work and stay reachable — they are just no longer offered for new tasks.
